name: Purvanchal Townhouse
label: At market value
overview: Purvanchal Townhouse is a limited collection of premium family residences in Al Furjan, Dubai, designed to offer privacy, comfort, and modern living within one of the city's well-established residential communities. Featuring spacious four-bedroom townhouses, the development combines elegant architecture, functional layouts, and quality finishes to create homes that support contemporary family lifestyles. With a focus on space, convenience, and community living, the project presents a distinctive residential opportunity for homeowners and investors alike.
